text:
Which of the daughters of burning summer,

candid rose, equals your beauty,

the softest complexion and the freshness

that spring from your shining face?


The rosy light of newborn dawn

shows no greater sweetness as it opens,

nor the wing of swans the whiteness

of the pilgrim circle of your brow.


Thus, glory of the garden, in the splendid

cluster you stand out from your green seat;

when, carried on the gentle wind,


to your fragrant silver chalice

a licentious insect steals its aroma,

and clouds the pure enamel with its breath.

translation.title: The White Rose
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the white rose's idealized purity and the final disturbance by the insect.
